results.title: Vicky Jain launches production house VJ Frames, announces action film with Tiger Shroff, Elvish Yadav and Abhishek Banerjee
results.description: Vicky Jain has ventured into film production with the launch of his banner, VJ Frames, on his birthday. The production house's first project is set to be a big-budget action film directed by Remo D'Souza and starring Tiger Shroff, Abhishek Banerjee, and Elvish Yadav.

results.title: CWG 2026: Praveen Chitravel wins silver; Selva Prabhu takes bronze in triple jump
results.description: Praveen Chitravel secured silver and Selva Prabhu Thirumaran earned bronze in the men's triple jump. Chitravel's best jump measured 16.58 meters, improving his previous performance. Thirumaran achieved his first major international medal with a jump of 16.52 meters. Jordan Scott of Jamaica claimed the gold medal with a jump of 16.72 meters. Ramesh Shanmugam finished seventh in the men's T54 1500m final.
